title: Variance of the Random k-SAT Hitting Time
summary: OpenAI 数学仓库收录的研究手稿。展开查看英文摘要，或标记后让我进一步解释。

abstractEnglish: Let Hn be the index of the first unsatisfiable prefix in random k-SAT on n variables, with independent uniformly signed clauses using k distinct variables and sampled with replacement. For every fixed k ≥ 4, we prove $`\mathop{\mathrm{Var}}\nolimits (H_n)=\Theta_k(n)`$. For k = 3, the variance is bounded below by a positive multiple of n and above by a constant multiple of $`n\log n`$; the companion paper on random 3-SAT sharpens this to $`\Theta(n)`$. The same upper bounds proved here hold after clipping at any fixed positive multiple of n.
titleEn: Variance of the Random k-SAT Hitting Time

details.overview: 稿件研究随机k-SAT中首个不可满足前缀索引Hn的方差。模型为n个变量、独立均匀符号、使用k个不同变量且放回抽样的子句。作者声称，对每个固定k≥4，Var(Hn)=Θ_k(n)；对k=3，方差下界为正的n倍数，上界为n log n的常数倍，伴随的随机3-SAT论文将其改进为Θ(n)。文中证明的上界在截断于任意固定正n倍数后仍成立。
keyPoints: 对k=3，给出下界Ω(n)与上界O(n log n)。
上界在截断于任意固定正n倍数后仍成立。
